note: An optional when: given a binding, the text shows only while it is set (a row's notes, a venue), instead of a core://Conditional around the use

component.doc: A text in the muted colour, with no padding of its own: a row's second line or trailing detail (a date, a count, a status), a caption beside a heading, a sentence in a card. Secondary text by default; max_lines cuts it short. Given when (a binding such as $item.notes), the text shows only while that value is set, so an optional field's line is one use. For a muted line inset 4 dp to line up with a card's edge (an empty state, a hint under a heading) use core:muted_note.

params.name: style
params.doc: A core://Text style (Caption for a smaller detail, Label for a quiet heading).

params.name: max_lines
params.doc: The most lines it takes; 0 for no limit.

params.name: when
params.doc: A binding (such as $item.notes, often the field the text shows): the text shows only while it is set, as a core://Conditional's value. Left out, the text always shows.

examples.note: the details under an item's title on its screen
